title: SELECT within WHERE clause changes between 1.3.23 and 1.4.4

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
I use a `.in_(select([...]))` construction: something like `select(scan.xxx).where(scan.id.in_(select(port.scan.id.where(...))))` (the exact code is [here](https://github.com/cea-sec/ivre/blob/master/ivre/db/sql/__init__.py#L1955)).

this code used to work (1.3.23) and no longer works (1.4.4). I would like to understand whether my code was wrong in the first place or if the API has changed, and how I should code that.

Using `git bisect`, a9b62055bfa61c11e9fe0b2984437e2c3e32bf0e seems to be the "guilty" commit.

With the current SQLAchemy code, I get the following stacktrace:

Thanks in advance!
